column1: # Labels of Factorio itself that the user topics (docs/user/) name in bold. CI cannot read the game, so the docs label
# test (clock-generator/tests/docs/user-labels.test.ts) accepts the labels of this list. Each row: the label as the
# topics write it, its key in the English locale of Factorio 2.1 (section.key, data/*/locale/en/*.cfg), and the
# string the game has for that key. For a keyboard key, the game string is the name of its modifier key.
# `npm run docs:game-labels` (from clock-generator/) checks the list against an installed game.
